description: Pluggable hook that parses an uploaded import file into rows and detected columns. Supply an implementation to TmImportWizard to power its parse and column-mapping flow. The core library ships a dependency-free CSV implementation (CsvImportFileParser); this interface is the extension point that lets a future package provide an XLSX or JSON parser without any change to the wizard.

members.name: ParseAsync
members.description: Parses the supplied stream into detected columns and raw string rows using the given options.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Readable stream of the uploaded file's bytes.

parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: Token used to cancel the operation.
